entries.name: Fix bugs
entries.detail: Satan, Linken's Sphere, Ogre Hood, Eye of Skadi, Aegis of Immortals, and Bloodstone their special effects or maximum‑health‑modifying effects missing.

entries.name: Host player point reward rules
entries.detail: Upon starting a game, the host player automatically pledges a portion of points for credit. Hosts with better historical credit need to pledge fewer points (three tiers: ‑100 / ‑60 / ‑20). Points will be forfeited if the host quits early. Points will be returned to the host as +120 points upon full completion of the match.

entries.name: Fixed bugs
entries.detail: incorrect rank evaluation caused by point pledging, and unintended loss of point triggered by match abortion.

entries.name: Badge for Premium local hosts will be awarded later
